name: cc-cache-warming
description: Keep Claude Code's main-session prompt cache warm while you are away

plugins.name: cc-cache-warming
plugins.description: Keeps the main session's 1h prompt cache warm for up to 6 h after your last real task: Monitor pings in the same session, a prompt hook gates each ping and blocks its tools, and every ping is verified from transcript cache tokens. Stops on misses, rewrites, 5m TTL, model switches and API/quota errors.
